parsed.title: Priority Routing Speed Boost
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock 15 minutes of priority speed for faster replies by playing a quick game.
parsed.trigger: When the user lands on the memory paywall screen (s03) and is blocked from advanced context.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users reaching the memory wall.

offer.title: Try Priority Speed
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock Priority Routing for 15 minutes.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 15 minutes and capped at 2 uses per day, ensuring the Janitor Plus subscription remains the only way to get permanent memory and full-session priority routing [TAX-4] [CANN-2].
risks: Potential devaluation of the Janitor Plus subscription if short speed bursts reduce the perceived value of full priority routing.
Engineering effort for real-time entitlement toggling for priority routing.
